summary: In this tutorial on JChemPaint, you will learn how to customize the software's interface. You start by opening the JChemPaint window from the command line on Ubuntu Linux OS. To change the background color, go to the "Edit" menu, then "Preferences," select the "Background Color" button, and choose your preferred color from the available options. For changing the user interface language, navigate to "Other Preferences," select "Look and Feel," and choose "Nimbus." To include templates, open the "Templates" menu, select "System Templates," and choose the desired template for the side toolbar. You can also create and manage structure templates by clicking on the "Structure Templates" tab, which displays various structure templates for different chemical structures.
